primary_claim: GPT-4-base has memorized (perfectly recalled) several BIG-Bench benchmark tasks that contain the canary string, evidencing training-data contamination by benchmark data that was supposed to be excluded.

effect.metric: tasks with perfectly recalled canary-containing code

limitations_stated: was constrained on time, so automated the process only partially and tested a subset of tasks manually
methodology for eliciting memorization was rudimentary
did not test all tasks in the benchmark, so more sophisticated methods would likely find additional compromised tasks
quote: After testing a subset of the BIG-Bench benchmark tasks, I found that GPT-4-base had memorized several tasks in the benchmark (all containing the canary string).
